activePlots.summary: 'Hatchet' Imre of the Gallows Crew killed Marta Venn and kidnapped Sabine's brother Gideon. Sabine has found the Gallows camp but the colony is weak after another raid.
activePlots.publicHint: The Gallows Crew is holding a doctor captive at their camp

recentEvents: Second Gallows Crew raid repelled day 339, four wounded
Toxic fallout has lasted six days
publicEvents: Toxic fallout is covering the region
The Gallows Crew is said to be holding a doctor at their camp
previousBulletins: The sky has turned the colour of a bad bruise, and the rain is worse. Toxic fallout is now in its sixth day across the region; the Saltmarch Assembly advises everyone to stay indoors and everyone else to stay indoors as well.
The Gallows Crew is boasting of a captive doctor. Doctors are worth more alive than dead, which is the only good thing I can say about the situation.

reporter.name: Odile Brask
reporter.persona: sardonic, precise and fond of understatement
